# Tutorial Selection Router — two-minute triage (V1.3)

**Before research or drafting, apply [value gate](TUTORIAL-VALUE-AND-MONETIZATION-GATE.md).** This short router exists so the V1.3 policy has a repeatable operational entry.

| Question | If yes | If no |
|---|---|---|
| Which specific role completes what recurring work? | Record persona + cadence | HOLD generic idea |
| Is a concrete AI/automation mechanism required? | Name repo/source/version + I/O | REFERENCE ONLY; not an AI tutorial |
| Can we measure net work value? | Path A: before/after + human QA + operating costs | Try Path B |
| Is there a lawful commercial service to validate? | Path B: buyer + deliverables + offer/price HYPOTHESIS + acquisition + costs + pilot | HOLD |
| Are claims current, legitimate and properly licensed? | Verify platform primary docs, identity, sample rights, source license | REJECT unsafe or obsolete |
| Can a reader reproduce and independently check the result? | Scope actual run and proof, then score ≥24/30 | REPRO_PENDING; don't claim tutorial tested |
| Is the full guide publicly reachable and does the X copy have a checked PNG/JPG+ALT? | Human publication may be approved | DRAFT; never claim public guide or posted status |

**Examples tied to four supplied X posts**:
- StackChan: **adopt** actual voice task + exact gate and permissions; **do not claim** zero marginal cost without confirmed billing and hardware/subscription accounting.
- Xianyu: **borrow** end-to-end operating checklist; **reject** fake SKUs, self-buying sales, identity misrepresentation and republished photos; ordinary shop tricks alone fail AI-content scope.
- X revenue: **old guide blocked**; Sept 7 2026 program sunset, new [Original Content Rewards](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/original-content-rewards). Do not teach stale forms as current or advise tax/location workarounds.
- Rachel: **borrow** research → script → video → compliance → publishing → measurement; her earnings are **self-reported only**, and [dbskill](https://github.com/dontbesilent2025/dbskill) CC BY-NC rights must be respected.

**Source register:** [Four X editorial audit](TUTORIAL-FOUR-X-REFERENCE-AUDIT-2026-10-25.md) · [candidate tracking CSV](../templates/tutorial-work-value-candidates.csv). `RESEARCH_CANDIDATE` never means tested or monetized.
